sentences.text: Loretta L. Sánchez -LRB- born January 7 , 1960 -RRB- is an American politician who served in the United States House of Representatives from 1997 to 2017 .	United States House of Representatives	United States House of Representatives
She was first elected in 1996 , when she defeated long-serving Republican congressman Bob Dornan by fewer than 1,000 votes .	Bob Dornan	Bob Dornan	Republican	Republican Party (United States)
Sánchez represented the 46th district from 1997 to 2003 , then from 2003 to 2013 , and again in the 46th district from 2013 to 2017 .
The district lies in central Orange County .	Orange County	Orange County, California

Since 1996 , Sánchez has been a member of the Democratic Party , and of the centrist House Blue Dog Coalition .	Democratic	Democratic Party (United States)	Democratic Party	Democratic Party (United States)	Blue Dog Coalition	Blue Dog Coalition

Sánchez chose not to run for re-election to the House in 2016 , instead opting to run for the U.S. Senate race in California .	California	California	U.S. Senate race in California	United States Senate election in California, 2016
California Attorney General Kamala Harris defeated Sanchez , 61.6 % to 38.4 % .	California	California	Kamala Harris	Kamala Harris
